natural_language: Complete four pearls in a straight line before the clockwork rival. Read the transparent 4×4×4 volume, defend the rival's visible three-pearl threat, then exploit the remaining cross-depth fork. Click the lattice field to cycle the preview through legal (x,z) columns and click the separate area below the lattice to confirm; pearls fall to the lowest free layer. You have at most eight player placements. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
